name: dsh-rss-monitor
description: RSS 订阅监控插件：定时检查 RSS 源、关键词过滤、邮件通知，并以原生设置页接入 DeepSeek Harness。 Monitor RSS feeds on a schedule, filter by keywords, and get email notifications, as a native DeepSeek Harness settings page. v0.2.9 mounts the settings RPC as exact Fetch routes under the shared /api channel (/api/dsh-rss-monitor.<endpoint>): dsh-client-connection exposes fetch.register without touching webServer, which fixes the load failure "cannot get property \"webServer\" without inject" (the desktop loader ignores module-level inject), and browser requests ride the same authenticated /api transport as every other settings tab instead of plugin channels that can fall through to the static-frontend fallback (HTTP 405). v0.2.8 fixed email delivery under TUN-mode proxies (nodemailer c-ares queryA ETIMEOUT; SMTP hosts pre-resolved via the OS resolver with TLS SNI preserved) and added a client bundle version guard + prepack rebuild. v0.2.10 tightens the host declaration to the verified floor: dsh-client-connection shipped the Fetch-route API (registerFetchRoute) starting 0.1.2-rc.1 and removed rpc.handle there, so engines.dsh is now >=0.1.2-rc.1 (verified against every published connection release; the older 0.1.0/0.1.1 line cannot run the /api transport).
